name: fraction_role
description: Identify numerator versus denominator from a referenced part of a fraction; controls copy the explicitly provided numeric part.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(120):
 a,b=random.sample(range(2,100),2);v=a if i%2==0 else b
 items.append({'prompt':f'In the fraction {a}/{b}, the number {v} is the','answer':' '+('numerator' if v==a else 'denominator')})
 controls.append({'prompt':f'In the fraction {a}/{b}, the referenced number is {v}. That number is','answer':' '+str(v)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
